name: question-relevance-reformulation
control: Competent conventional investigator researches brief questions, follows leads, reads governing evidence and synthesizes a complete draft.
treatment: Maintain question-indexed retrieval queues for original obligations AND emergent alternative leads. Score candidate passages for question relevance/applicability, keep exact full evidence available outside contextual evidence cards, and reformulate only an unanswered question from its missing governing condition. Three working cards per question is a context prioritization rule, NEVER a cap on investigation, evidence or preserved output. Explicitly expand to surrounding definitions/exceptions when cards insufficient. Same native context/time and finalizer.
novelty: Question-specific rank/contextualize/reformulate loop, distinct from repository navigation and evidence-before-proposal.
adaptation_limit: Paper/implementation mechanisms motivate the intervention; published benchmark gains are NOT ER11 evidence.
